system: Izu Campanula microdonta direct effective-pollinator dependency pilot
purpose: Prospective end-to-end ecological test of CREST snapshot sufficiency. This registry does not promote historical causation and does not count the finite CREST theorem as empirically proved.

requires: linked plant effort visit SVD treatment fruit records
no_visit or bagged-unvisited SVD background controls
terminal outcomes for open_pollinated bagged_autonomous supplemental_outcross
snapshot variables frozen before response readout
admitted background-adjusted SVD for at least one visitor group

G3_snapshot_insufficiency_demonstrated.criterion: At least one reproducible snapshot-merged plant/population pair or class shows a prespecified response disagreement with independent-plant support.

G4_interpretable_refinement_repairs_disa.criterion: Adding a biologically interpretable dependency or visitor-functional distinction improves held-out prediction or removes systematic response disagreement without simply adding identifiers.

G5_evidence_licenses_refined_state.criterion: The admitted monitoring channels distinguish the refined state at the declared uncertainty level.

G6_coarse_target_retained.criterion: At least one prespecified coarse target remains reportable even if full refined-state identification fails.

claim_firewalls: No modern response difference by itself identifies historical Bombus loss as the cause.
No SVD channel is admitted without source-locked background controls and independent-plant dispersion support.
Flowers and repeated visits within a plant are subsamples, not independent n.
The focal pilot does not identify transportable final dependency reliability without the separate izu-core repeated-final-estimand gate.
A successful Izu case validates the ecological projection for this contract; it does not prove the arbitrary-m finite theorem.
current_conclusion: The end-to-end empirical test is designed but not yet open because source field measurement admission is blocked by collection.
